title: slack-notice config
description: .config/slack-notice/config.yaml under the home directory from the password database (HOME and XDG_CONFIG_HOME are not read; an unusable home directory is exit 2 with key home) plus config.d/*.yaml beside it in lexical order. Invalid config exits 2 (config_invalid), naming the key. Drop-ins: maps merge. Precedence: flags, then config, then defaults; there are no environment overrides. Files are parsed with a strict YAML loader (duplicate keys, tags, anchors and aliases refused, so `<<: *alias` is refused because the alias is, while a literal `<<` key is an ordinary string key refused later as unknown; and hex, octal, sexagesimal, leading-zero and .inf/.nan numbers refused), regular files of at most 65536 bytes. Self-contained: no external references.

duration.description: Seconds as a positive finite number, or a string matching [0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(ms|s|m)? (no unit means seconds); zero is refused. Booleans are never accepted. Ranges are enforced by the loader and named in the key's description.

enabled.description: false makes send exit 22 without reading input or the credential.

webhook_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the trigger URL. The URL itself is never in config.

body_variable.description: Name of the workflow's text variable.

level_prefix.description: Per-level message prefixes. The schema is a coarse gate: the loader's sanitizer-based check is authoritative for invisible and format characters, leading or trailing whitespace and repeated spaces.

One-line prefixes, 1 to 16 characters each; a value that the title rule (sanitizer steps 1 to 5) would change is config_invalid at load. Length counts code points, not bytes or grapheme clusters (16 emoji of one code point each are allowed, 17 are not). The class excludes every control character (U+0000 to U+001F, U+007F to U+009F) and U+2028 and U+2029, because the sanitizer removes or rewrites them (steps 2 and 3).

max_chars.description: Body limit in Unicode code points; a 12000-byte cap on the request body also applies. The loader accepts decimal integers only and refuses a fraction such as 3000.0.

timeout.description: The one monotonic deadline of a send (input, lock wait, network, retries), 3s to 120s.
